verdict.summary: Round 4 remains correct and complete on diff-scoped review. Collection identity is retained independently from request membership evidence; positive allow heads expand only to evidenced members, while collection-valued denies, carve-outs, and zero-evidence allows take the one-shot path. The tests exercise both emitted graph shape and the real PodStore enforcement path, including zero-edge and policy-stated membership cases, and are not vacuous. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue. Progress is stagnant because round 3 already had zero findings and this round likewise has none. Targeted tests could not be rerun because cargo is unavailable in the checkout environment.
